description: Shared expectations for the 0.x version check: both tools' suites assert these exact messages for the same lockfile resolutions, so the two tools cannot drift apart. {pinned} is the mapping's v0Version.

cases.refusal: Daytona SDK 0.999.0-alpha.1 ({file}) is newer than {pinned}, the 0.x release this daytona-upgrade and SDK 2.x run as .v0: 0.x APIs added after {pinned} are missing from .v0 and would get no FIXME. Use a later daytona-upgrade release, or rerun with --allow-newer-v0 to migrate anyway. No files were written.

cases.warning: Daytona SDK 0.100.0 is older than {pinned}, the 0.x release SDK 2.x runs as .v0. Calls moved to .v0 now run {pinned}; review the 0.x changes between 0.100.0 and {pinned}, then run your tests.
